description: updateDnsRecord: Update an existing DNS record. Requires authentication. Only the fields you provide are changed; omitted fields keep their current values. Get the recordId from listDnsRecords. Returns the updated record.

content.description: New record value, e.g. an IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6 address, hostname, or text.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name the record belongs to, e.g. 'example.com'.

name.description: New record name relative to the zone, e.g. 'www' or '@' for the apex.

priority.description: New priority for MX/SRV records only.

recordId.description: Identifier of the record to update, as returned by listDnsRecords.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

ttl.description: New time to live in seconds.

type.description: New record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA.

name: updateDnsRecord
